summary: Tech View: drag grip on every row and technician header (none on Unassigned header)
description:
h3. What

Show the design's six-dot drag grip at the left of every Tech View row and technician group header (not the Unassigned header).

h3. Expected

S9-R1a (v53): "In Tech View every work order row, Unassigned's rows included, shows the design's six-dot drag grip at its left edge to users who can drag work orders (S4-N1). Every technician group header shows the grip to every user who can reorder technicians (S9-R2), view-only users included, because the technician order is personal. The Unassigned group header shows no grip, because Unassigned cannot move (S9-R8). The whole row still drags (S2-R8); the grip shows that it can."

PRD: [Board View & Tech View PRD v51|https://shopview.atlassian.net/wiki/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=845185030] (S9-R1a).

h3. Actual (staging build, develop b19269d4487, clicked through locally)

Rows show no grip, although dragging a row works. Technician group headers have a grip; Unassigned has none.

h3. How to check

* A user with Work Orders create and edit sees a grip on every work order row, Unassigned's rows included.
* A view-only user sees no row grips, but does see the grip on every technician group header and can reorder technicians. The Unassigned group header shows no grip to anyone.
* Dragging from anywhere on the row still works; a click still opens the work order.

h3. Screenshots

Attached: staging build first, Branko's design (files starting D) after.

Raised from Sasha's staging review, 2026-10-14.

h3. PRD v54 update (2026-10-15)

* S9-R1a reworded per grip (v53): row grips follow who can drag work orders (S4-N1); every technician group header shows the grip to everyone who can reorder technicians (S9-R2), view-only users included; the Unassigned header has no grip because Unassigned cannot move (S9-R8).

* [C590117|https://shopview.testrail.io/index.php?/cases/view/590117] Tech View group headers show grip, arrow, avatar, name and count as designed
